title: Offbeat Vietnam Sightseeing Tour
highlights: Marvel at the beautiful limestone structures over the azure blue waters in Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Huddled with old karst mountains, thick green forests, and scintillating underground rivers, Phong Nha is a paradise for cavers around the world.
Walk above the mist-laden mountains on the golden bridge that was built to evoke the image of God’s hands pulling a strip of gold out of the land.
Treat your taste buds to the delicious Vietnamese cuisine made by the locals on your visit to Tam Coc.
Get a shivering sensation as you watch the horror of the Vietnam War on the former battlegrounds at the Cu Chi Tunnels.
overview:
About the Tour:
Caving and Cruising through the hidden gems of Vietnam is what makes this Ultimate Vietnam Sightseeing Tour. Explore the offbeat places of Vietnam with UNESCO World Heritage recognition consisting of some world's largest caves, the most beautiful bays, and scenic meandering rivers, giving you some memorable experiences of a lifetime.
Along with the urban beat of the major cities like Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh, and Da Nang, you will also get a chance to spend some time in the lap of nature at Halong Bay, Phong Nha, and Tam Coc. Adding to the ultimate experiences in this tour is your visit to the historic Cu Chi Tunnels which played a major role in the Vietnam War.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Upon arrival in Hanoi, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. Spend the day at leisure or explore the famous attractions like Ngoc Son Temple, Hoan Kiem Lake, Temple of literature, etc. Afterwards, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh province
days.desc: Enjoy a trip to Ninh Binh City. Get transferred from the hotel to visit the Hao Lu and the ancient temples of the Le Dinh Dynasties. Explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc on a boat ride from Hao Lu. Conclude your day cycling through the village, from Tam Coc to Bich Dong Pagoda. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing cruise experience. Check-out and get transferred to Tuan Chau Harbor via the Red River Delta area and board your overnight cruise. Upon your arrival, have a warm welcome and relax for a while. As the cruise sails ahead, enjoy a visit to Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village. Also, attend a cooking session while you are there on the cruise. Afterward, enjoy your overnight stay at the cruise.

Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Board your overnight Halong Bay Cruise from Tuan Chau Harbor after a scenic drive through the Red River Delta. 
Once on the cruise, you will get to relax and enjoy the amazing views of Halong Bay from the cruise. 
You will also visit the famous islets and attractions of Halong bay, like the Ti Top island and the pearl farm village. 
Return to the deck and attend a fun cooking class of authentic Vietnamese cuisine. 
Enjoy your overnight stay at the cruise with entertainment and amazing service.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi | Transfer to Dong Hoi
days.desc: Begin the day with a Tai Chi lesson on the deck. Later, explore the wonderful caves around Halong Bay before getting transferred to Hanoi airport from Tuan Chau Harbor. Upon your arrival at the airport, board your flight to Dong Hoi (flight tickets included). After reaching Dong Hoi, get transferred to the hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Begin your morning with a beautiful sunrise and Tai Chi lesson on the sun deck. 
Afterwards, enjoy delicious Vietnamese food and visit the Surprise Caves, one of the largest caves in Halong Bay.
Your cruise will drop you off at Tuan Chau Harbor, and you can continue your journey from there.

End your trip by visiting Linh Ung Pagoda, which houses a Lady Buddha & Debay Wine Cellar. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Chi Minh | Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport to board your flight to Ho Chi Minh City (flight tickets included). After arrival, board your pre-booked transfer to the hotel and check-in. After relaxing for a while, prepare yourself for a half-day tour of the Cu Chi tunnels after lunch time. Explore Vietnam's wartime tunnels, an important part of Vietnamese history, and later get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
